summary: The letter M tucks three fingers over the thumb. Three fingers for M, two for N.
steps: Tuck your thumb into your palm.
Fold the index, middle, and ring fingers down over it.
Pinky stays folded against the palm.
mistakes: Folding only two fingers. That's N. Count the humps: M has three.

faq.q: How do I tell M from N?
faq.a: M covers the thumb with three fingers; N with two. Think of the number of humps in the printed letter.
